{{Quote|What kind of planet ''is'' Vorzyd 5, anyway&ndash;?''"<br />"''They call it ''Gambler's World'', Threepio! ... A planet with ''no limit'' ... where ''anything goes''&ndash;!|C-3PO and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="GamblersWorld">"[[Gambler's World]]"</ref>}}
'''Vorzyd V''', also known as '''Vorzyd 5''', '''Vorzyd-5''', or '''Gambler's World''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Vorzyd system/Legends|Vorzyd system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
Occupying the fifth and outermost [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Vorzyd]], Vorzyd V was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Vorzyd system/Legends|Vorzyd system]],<ref name="GATORW" /> located within the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> With a diameter of 14,900 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], the world possessed standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], a temperate climate, and no [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Its terrain was largely urban, though plains were also present on its surface. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Vorzyd V lasted 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard]] [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 277 standard days.<ref name="GATORW" />

Due to the wealth of Vorzyd V, the Vorzyd system was an important part of the [[Commonality]], a confederacy of nine [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] centered around the trading world of [[Columex/Legends|Columex]]. Vorzyd V had a democratic government<ref name="GATORW" /> with a [[Prime Minister (Vorzyd V)|Prime Minister]],<ref name="HNN52">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|business/13418_1.html|Leisure Industry Suffers Record Losses}}</ref> and while the planet had no major exports, it received imports including consumer goods, industrial goods, and [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]]. [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]], the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of Vorzyd V, hosted a number of lavish [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], which were marketed by holographic advertisements in the world's orbital traffic lanes.<ref name="GATORW" />

==History==
[[File:VorzydsUnrulyYouth.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Partying youth on Vorzyd V.]]
Once a colony world of the people of [[Vorzyd IV]], the [[Vorzydiak]]s that lived there gave all their physical work over to labor [[Droid/Legends|droids]], valuing leisure and games over hard work.

Around [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], the people of Vorzyd V began to build the casinos and amusement parks for which their world would later become famous. During this time, the citizens of [[Vorzyd IV]] accused the people of Vorzyd V of sabotaging their monitoring systems and factories. After investigation by the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], it was found to be caused by the [[Freelies]], a youth movement native to Vorzyd IV.

The Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]], better known as "Scout" was born on Vorzyd V in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Prime Minister of Vorzyd V was [[Kalasaad Woztu]].<ref name="HNN52" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Vorzyd system was within space controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the heavy taxation and strict gaming laws of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began to weigh heavily upon the people of Vorzyd V. Due to this, [[President/Legends|President]] [[Natala Vanden]] of the Gambler's World became a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizer and set up a meeting with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to begin negotiations for their defection to the Rebel Alliance.

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Vorzyd system fell within the boundaries of the [[Greater Maldrood]], a section of space that was fortified by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] during the disorder that followed the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], under pressure from a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|campaign]], Teradoc abandoned his territories, including the area surrounding Vorzyd V, which were then annexed by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Vorzyd V was outside of the core territory of the shrinking Empire, but it was within space affiliated with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic. By [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had taken control of the Vorzyd system. By [[137 ABY]], Vorzyd V was within space claimed by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="TEA" />
